_comment: Extra directories the MiniMax H3 Director media picker may browse, beyond
Copy this file to media_roots.json (same folder) and edit the paths.
Absolute paths; Windows paths need doubled backslashes in JSON.
The file is re-read whenever it changes: no ComfyUI restart needed.
Requests name a root by id, never by path, so clients cannot read arbitrary locations.
Roots whose 'path' does not exist are ignored (a log line is written).
